title: Purple Hearts
description: Simple resource pack that changes the default red hearts to a stylish purple color
body:
![please note, hardcore hearts do not change (I will fix this in the future)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ff96cdb74dd9b9968f3776946f0fbe67dfb26314.png)![A screenshot of the Minecraft game interface, on which the standard red health hearts are replaced by bright purple ones](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8382b292a1551b88fcba982c03f9967e16083fdc.png)This resource pack is a simple yet stylish UI tweak for Minecraft. It replaces all the standard red heart icons with a vibrant purple version. The pack includes custom textures for full hearts, half hearts, and empty heart containers.
It was specifically designed for Minecraft 1.21.x and works perfectly on the latest versions like 1.21.8. It's a great choice for players who want to customize their HUD with a unique purple theme. No additional mods are required!
